pruningDecision.rationale: 30 components consist of isolated single nodes with 0 edges (rasterization grid artifacts). 3 components (Comp 19: 3 nodes in Seno Otway, Comp 23: 2 nodes in Canal Smyth, Comp 31: 2 nodes in Canal Messier) represent legitimate navigable waterways with valid internal edges that are retained for future high-resolution coastal channel/gateway work.
